messages:
dana: Heads-up: BlueHarbor reported a batch of AWS Marketplace usage for 2026-03-15 to 2026-03-16 imported into our system as 'unattributed'. They say BuyerReference is their partner acct.

tom-eng: Can you paste a sample row so we can see the BuyerReference value?

dana: Sample from their metering CSV:
```
TxId,Start,End,BuyerReference,ProductCode,Quantity,Cost
bh-333,2026-03-15,2026-03-15,blueharbor-master-777,redwood-llm,1800,36.00
```

ali-fin: If unmapped those downstream customers won't get proper invoices and commissions will be off. We need a reconciliation plan and provisional credits.

partner-ops: BlueHarbor says they had a report template rollback on 2026-03-14 that switched BuyerReference to partner master id. They've uploaded a downstream mapping file for Mar15-16 and offered to re-export corrected rows.

tom-eng: Short-term mitigation: add a fallback in marketplace-ingest to consult partner-specific mapping S3 artifacts when BuyerReference matches a known partner pattern. I can have a patch and staging canary in ~48hrs.

ali-fin: Finance needs a CSV to create provisional credit memos: downstream_customer_id, affected_cost, invoice_period, partner_ref, original_tx_count. We'll mark them provisional pending partner re-export.

partner-ops: BlueHarbor approved provisional PO and has uploaded mapping to the ticket evidence. They'll run a backfill for Mar 14-16 if needed.

billingbot: audit: ticket-7205 created; blueharbor_mapping_mar15_16.csv uploaded to /evidence/ticket-7205/ at 2026-03-16T11:05:22Z.

dana: Let's keep this thread open until re-export and credits are reconciled. Linking JIRA BILL-7205 for follow-ups. Thanks all.
